entities.summary: Zachary Michael Sanford is an American professional ice hockey forward for HC Lugano of the National League (NL). He was drafted 61st overall by the Washington Capitals at the 2013 NHL entry draft. Sanford won the Stanley Cup with the St. Louis Blues in 2019.
